sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and learned App for the State.

2.  This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant namely Anil Munda @ Anil Kumar Munda with prayer to release on bail in connection with Ramgarh (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 03 of 2024, corresponding to S.T No. 73 of 2024, registered under Section 376& 417 of the IPC, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge,-I, Ramgarh.

3. FIR of this case was lodged by the victim herself wherein the allegations are made that this petitioner had established physical relationship with her on the pretext of marriage for last four years.
Last time i.e on 25.11.2023 he took her to his house village Jamura where he established physical relation with her.
Whenever, she insisted the petitioner to solemnize marriage with her then he threatened that he is a member of banned extremist organization and will kill her entire family members.
The statement of victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C in which she stated that she was having love affair with the petitioner for last four years.
Many times physical relationship established between them and in month of December, she came to know that this petitioner is going to marry with another lady.
On being asked by the victim, he stated he would act at the behest of his family members.
The age of victim is shown as 22 years in the statement.

Since four years back she was having love affair with the petitioner and the victim was major at that point of time, I am inclined to allow the bail application of the petitioner.

Hence, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only)
with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.
